scripts.dev: npm run build -w @rf/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @rf/shared" "npm run dev -w @rf/api" "npm run dev -w @rf/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rf/shared && npm run build -w @rf/api && npm run build -w @rf/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rf/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rf/api && npm run typecheck -w @rf/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rf/api && npm run test -w @rf/web
